scenario: Eight factions, 384 civilian traders, Modern source buildings, three-building source/receiver stacks, 12000 ticks, 1000 warm-up ticks. Trade-only timings; no concurrent test or soak processes during the paired runs.

tradeOnly.coldRestore: Exact equality after 100 continuation ticks in both implementations
tradeOnly.interpretation: About 5% more mean trade work, about 41% lower p95, 57% fewer market reads. Additional successful stops require more route requests; the existing admission budget remains in force. This is not a whole-game performance improvement claim.

denseFullMatch.scenario: 16 regular factions plus 30 tribes, initially 1024 warships, 500 ticks, 100 warm-up ticks; finishes with 3459 squads and 583 ships in both bundles
denseFullMatch.strict50MsGate: Failed in both runs; combat and territorial capture remain the largest phases. Timing differences are not attributed solely to trade.

balance.receivingRate: One internal good per second per completed receiving building, capped at ten per tile. Shared land/sea budget, no per-trader reset.
balance.note: Sustained receiving ceilings, not guaranteed income; initial burst, travel, stock, cargo capacity and capture affect observed income. Long-match balance remains an experimental playtest concern.
